scenes.text: This tutorial covers Regression. Estimate perturbation effects and identify features associated with guide or condition-level phenotypes.
Open Regression from the Core section. Select mapped measurements, response variables, controls, grouping columns, and candidate predictors.
In the main configuration area, choose transformations, covariates, model family, random effects, multiple-testing correction, and quality filters.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. inspect model diagnostics and control behavior before interpreting coefficients.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR writes effect sizes, uncertainty, adjusted significance, diagnostics, and figures.
